Review Which Companies a User Can Access

User manual · English · 6 steps
Learn how to check the companies a user is allowed to work in and which one is their default.

1. Open Settings

Open the Settings app.

2. Users & Companies

Open the Users & Companies menu.

3. Users

Click Users.

4. Open a user

Click a user to open the record.

5. Allowed Companies

Click Allowed Companies to look at it.

6. Default Company

Click Default Company to look at it.
